$comment: REQUIREMENTS #505 -- how the Risk Analysis reports moved from the v2 profile tables (SI_*_Profile_CL, which stop at v3, D14) to the CI (SI_CI_CL). columnMap: every legacy profile column a report read -> what the report reads now (an SI field of data-model/field-catalog.locked.json, an expression over SI fields, the CI link key, or 'provider' when the reports read that column from a provider table and keep doing so). graphOnly: the reports that legitimately keep a provider (Exposure Graph) query for part of the ASSET side, with the reason -- they still take tier, CMDB, criticality factor and asset risk factors from the CI. Read by tools/ra-ci/Get-RaReportInventory.ps1 and tests/pester/SIv3-RaReadsCi.Tests.ps1.

AssetEngine.note: the profile's engine name; the CI's class says the same

AssetName.note: also a provider column (EG NodeName) in the graph reports, where it stays a display value, never a join key

AssetTags.note: the CI's tags as lower-case text (_ciLink / _ciAsset); the exclusion and tier-tag filters read it

AzureResourceId_Guid.note: was the ARM id joined on; the join is now _ciKey == lower(ARM id)

CmdbMatchPhase.dropped: profile plumbing; the CI holds the owning CMDB's values (D11)

CmdbMatchState.dropped: profile plumbing; the CI holds the owning CMDB's values (D11)

CollectionTime.dropped: the profile row's time; the CI block picks the newest build

CriticalityLevel.note: the graph reports derive it from EG criticality; the CI tier now decides

DaysInactive.note: derived; the profile's own value was the same difference

EntityIds.note: read from ExposureGraphNodes.EntityIds (the SenseDeviceId / AadObjectId / AzureResourceId the finding is joined to its CI with)

ExcludedReason.note: the exclusion tag the CI's tags match (_excludedAssetTags)

ExclusionReason.note: DeviceInfo.ExclusionReason (MDE exclusion) on the finding side

IsExcluded.note: EG rawData.isExcluded / DeviceInfo on the finding side

IsInternetFacing.note: also DeviceInfo.IsInternetFacing on the TVM finding side (provider)

LastSignInDays.si: iff(set_has_element(si_unknown_fields, "si_last_sign_in"), long(null), iff(isnull(si_last_sign_in), -1, datetime_diff('day', now(), si_last_sign_in)))
LastSignInDays.note: -1 = KNOWN never signed in; a sign-in the CI could not decide for the identity's origin (si_unknown_fields) is null -- unknown is never a finding (#546)

MaxCvssScore.note: also an EG rawData value in the graph reports (provider)

ObjectType.note: User = user / guest; ServicePrincipal = service_principal; ManagedIdentity = managed_identity

PrimaryEntityId.note: the CI is the entity; a provider id is si_link_*

PasswordLastChangedDays.si: iff(isnull(si_password_last_changed) or set_has_element(si_unknown_fields, "si_password_last_changed"), long(null), datetime_diff('day', now(), si_password_last_changed))
PasswordLastChangedDays.note: no -1 sentinel: an unknown password age is null, so it can never satisfy > 365 (#546); the stale-password reports read the old_password factor

EgCriticalityLevel.note: the attack-path reports' own Exposure Graph criticality of an intermediate node (graph-only); the end assets take si_tier

AadDeviceId.note: a DeviceInfo / EG column on the finding side -- never a join key to the CI (the join is _ciKey == the SenseDeviceId / NodeId)
